ApproachScene.text1body: AN OMINOUS STRUCTURE STANDS BEFORE THE saint, THE HUMMING SOUND SEEMS TO COME FROM ITS DIRECTION. A VIVID LIGHT SHINES THROUGH THE CIRCULAR PORTAL AT THE BASE OF THE great monolith.  NOT COMPLETELY believing IT, THE saint PAUSES FOR A MOMENT TO GET HIS SENSES BACK.
ApproachScene.text2body:
There's no time.
He must see it through the end.

PillarCrumbleScene.text1body: THE saint GENTLY FLOATS BACK TO THE FLOOR, ONE FOOT AFTER THE OTHER. HIS ROBE, NOW SATURATED WITH THE COLOR OF THE MYSTERIOUS LIQUID.
PillarCrumbleScene.text2body: The sudden roar of shattering stone fills the air. The columns and roof begin to break apart and lift away, revealing a deep red sky.

ProfileScene.text1body: The saint finally catches a glimpse of what he was seeking since he went on his pilgrimage.
ProfileScene.text2body: At the sight of it, he stands taller, gaze fixated, and determination burning within.

WanderScene.text1body: In an immense land of nothingness, a lonely figure wanders through the mist.
WanderScene.text2body: Distant whispers alert the traveller. The saint removes his hood to look around, eyes unsure and fearful.
